description: EVE Isk per Hour: industry calculator for EVE Online that finds the most profitable manufacturing, invention, reactions and mining.
notes: Data (database, settings, ESI logins) lives in %APPDATA%\EVE IPH, outside the Scoop folder: it is
created on the first install from the files that come with the program, survives updates and is
kept on uninstall. An existing %APPDATA%\EVE IPH from the official installer is used as it is.
EVE IPH updates its program files and game database by itself on start (Settings > Application
Settings > Check for updates on start). Those updates come straight from upstream, without the
bucket's metadata check; turning the option off also stops database updates.
This bucket updates the package only after a metadata check of the new build
(bin/Test-NetMetadata.ps1, workflow iph-watch.yml), through a pull request.
pre_install: # Upstream's zip often lags behind its main program; the newer exe and its file list go on top.
# Without a database next to the exe, EVE IPH runs as if installed: database, settings and its updater
# live in %APPDATA%\EVE IPH. Seed that folder once; never overwrite it, it holds the user's data and
# the file list that EVE IPH compares with upstream to update its own database.
# The updater runs from that folder and migrates the database, so it needs the SQLite libraries next to it.
Write-Host "Created '$data' for the EVE IPH database and settings."

script: # The newest commit that touched the file list, and the version of the main program in that list.
